parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源 IP 地址
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current query. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when querying the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the database. You can obtain this value from Items[].InstanceId returned by ListDataMaskingInstances
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cloud product type. Valid values:
5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2.

This value must correspond to ProductCode if both are specified
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en:
The connection status of the data source. Valid values:
UnConnected: not connected.
Processing: connection in progress.
Success: connected.
Failed: connection failed
parameters.help_zh: 数据源连接状态。UnConnected：未连接；Processing：连接处理中；Success：连接成功；Failed：连接失败
parameters.name: connect_status

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: A reserved pagination parameter. ListDataSources currently uses CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination. Omit this parameter when calling the operation
parameters.help_zh: 保留的分页参数。当前 ListDataSources 使用 CurrentPage 和 PageSize 分页，调用时省略本参数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A reserved pagination cursor parameter. ListDataSources currently uses CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination. Omit this parameter when calling the operation
parameters.help_zh: 保留的分页游标参数。当前 ListDataSources 使用 CurrentPage 和 PageSize 分页，调用时省略本参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source in Data Security Center. You can obtain this value from Items[].DataSourceId returned by ListDataSources
parameters.help_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据源标识，从 ListDataSources 的 Items[].DataSourceId 获取
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en:
The detection switch status of the data source. Valid values:
Enable: enabling submitted.
Enabling: enabling in progress.
Enabled: enabled.
EnableFailed: enabling failed.
Disable: disabling submitted.
Disabling: disabling in progress.
Disabled: disabled.
DisableFailed: disabling failed
parameters.help_zh: 数据源识别开关状态。Enable：已提交开启；Enabling：开启中；Enabled：已开启；EnableFailed：开启失败；Disable：已提交关闭；Disabling：关闭中；Disabled：已关闭；DisableFailed：关闭失败
parameters.name: identify_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data asset in Data Security Center
parameters.help_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据资产标识
parameters.name: data_asset_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud product. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by the current query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

Processing: connection in progress.
Success: connected.

DataAssetId.description_en: The ID of the data asset in Data Security Center
DataAssetId.description_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据资产标识

DataSourceId.description_en: The ID of the data source in Data Security Center
DataSourceId.description_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据源标识

DataSourceSize.description_zh: 数据源容量统计值。关系型数据库的列加密流程不使用此字段

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code of the record or operation. This field can be empty if no error occurs. Evaluate it together with ErrorMessage
ErrorCode.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误码。无错误时可为空；应结合 ErrorMessage 判断

ErrorMessage.description_en: The business error message of the record or operation
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误说明

IdentifyStatus.description_en:
The detection switch status of the data source. Valid values:
Enable: enabling submitted.
Enabling: enabling in progress.
Enabled: enabled.
EnableFailed: enabling failed.
Disable: disabling submitted.
Disabling: disabling in progress.
Disabled: disabled.
DisableFailed: disabling failed
IdentifyStatus.description_zh: 数据源识别开关状态。Enable：已提交开启；Enabling：开启中；Enabled：已开启；EnableFailed：开启失败；Disable：已提交关闭；Disabling：关闭中；Disabled：已关闭；DisableFailed：关闭失败

InstanceId.description_en: The instance identity of the database

MemberAccount.description_en: The identity of the member accounts to which the asset belongs
MemberAccount.description_zh: 资产所属成员账号标识

ProductCode.description_en: The code of the cloud product

ProductId.description_en:
The ID of the cloud product type. Valid values:
5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the asset

RegionName.description_en: The region name of the asset

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the asset belongs

TenantId.description_en: The tenant ID of the database

UserName.description_en: The database account name used to connect to the data source
UserName.description_zh: 数据源连接使用的数据库账号名称

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records allowed to be returned by cursor-based pagination
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次游标分页允许返回的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: A compatible pagination cursor field. ListDataSources currently uses page-based pagination and does not rely on this field to determine whether more pages exist
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容的分页游标字段。当前 ListDataSources 使用页码分页，不依赖本字段判断是否还有下一页

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page for the current query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query or statistical scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量
